name: Ruben Morales
career_history: Sr Preconstruction Manager - Mechanical at The Weitz Company, 3/2022 to present; Senior MEP Cost Manager at Rider Levett Bucknall, 1/2018 to 3/2022; Pre-Construction Manager at TDIndustries, 6/2015 to 1/2018; Mechanical Lead Estimator, MEP Coordinator at Hunt Construction Group, 10/2008 to 6/2013; Sales Engineer / Business Development / Marketing at Comfort Systems USA, 5/2005 to 8/2008
education: Bachelor of Science, Mechanical Engineering, California State University-Northridge, 2003 to 2005
biography: Mechanical Engineer and Cost Manager in the HVAC and Plumbing Industries since 1990. • Have over 25 years experience in the mechanical field to include HVAC, plumbing, and fire sprinkler cost estimating and project management. Experience includes estimator, sales engineer, preconstruction, and project management at the general and subcontractor level. Project management includes scheduling, equipment ordering, provide and analyze change orders when change of scope occurs, billing, manpower scheduling. • Hands on experience in estimating with emphasis in conceptual and plan/spec projects. Heavily involved in the pre-construction phase of project, bringing owner budgets and construction needs together. Have managed estimating disciplines for HVAC (wet and dry), and all plumbing aspects. Constant involvement with engineers and vendors/suppliers to find best and most economical solution. • As an engineer, able to design and price complete mechanical projects from schematic development (SD) through construction drawings (CD). Conceptual estimates are done in full detail to include equipment, controls, ductwork, piping, and general conditions. • Experience in industrial projects having worked on Intel projects the past 10 years. Have also worked on billions of dollars worth of work with Data Centers, mostly Google, Facebook, and Tik-Tok.
